description: An icon button that writes a string to the clipboard, confirms in place with a glyph and a spoken word, and reverts on its own. A failed write is reported the same way, never hidden.

text.description: What is written to the clipboard, exactly as given. A blank text draws the button disabled, because there is nothing to copy. The text is data, so it is not guarded.

label.description: The button's accessible name, the same in every state. Absent or blank, the provided locale's copyButtonLabel answers it, which reads Copy by default. Name what is copied when a page holds more than one.

showLabel.description: Draws the name beside the glyph, as ArenaIconButton.showLabel does.

copied.description: The clipboard took the text. No payload, because the consumer already holds the text.

copyFailed.description: The clipboard refused the text, or the page has none, as on an insecure origin. No payload and never an error object.
